column1: # US (SCUS-97199) to PAL (SCES-50916) function map, from the code alone: python3 tools/overlays.py us-map
# program: boot (the US executable) or level_NN (level NN's overlay); the US address and size of a function;
# its PAL counterpart (config/overlays/functions.tsv's name, func_X for the executable's), or - if none.
# US functions are each text cut by split() and at the PAL functions found in it (masked instructions,
# near where the last one was), so they are cut as their counterparts are. Methods, in order:
#   fingerprint  identical instructions with address fields masked (identity()): aligned in address order
#                with the same program's PAL functions, else (16 bytes or more) code found once in the PAL
#   aligned      between two fingerprint anchors, paired in order by similarity (at least 0.5)
#   similar      elsewhere in the same program, the most similar unpaired function (at least 0.8,
# similarity: difflib's ratio over masked instructions (mask()); 1.00 when only constants differ.
# Addresses and names only; regenerate with the ReRAC extraction (docs/OVERLAYS.md, "US map").
